bio.text: Chris Van Hollen was elected to the U.S. Senate from Maryland in November 2016.
He began in public service in the Maryland State Legislature, and in 2002 was elected to represent Maryland's 8th Congressional District, where he became Ranking Member of the House Budget Committee.
Van Hollen is a graduate of Swarthmore College and Harvard's Kennedy School, and attended Georgetown University Law Center at night.
